title: Approval
description: An approval is a task of type gate that holds the tasks waiting on it out of ready work until a person approves the action it names. Its title names the action. Its description is the request: what the agent will do, what it changes, how the result will be confirmed, and what happens if the person declines. A task waits on it through a blocks link. Section 3.7 of the protocol.

pullRequest.description: The pull request the approval gates, such as one the agent may merge only once approved. It is part of the approval's proposal, and a server keeps it as the approval's link of kind pull-request. Null, or left out, when the approval gates none. STATE-24 says what an answer does to it.
